summary: Fusion is a self-hosted RSS reader that runs as a single user with no login. I saved 5 views, and each one replayed and matched my screen (similarity 0.96–1.00). (1) article-list: the main /unread workspace, with the sidebar of groups and feeds and their unread counts, plus the article list and its All/Unread/Starred tabs. (2) article-reader: /unread?article=119 opened directly by URL, showing the reader drawer with a formatted article (headings, numbered list, code block, quote) and the mark-read/star/original and previous/next controls. (3) manage-feeds: /feeds, listing feeds by group with error and suspended indicators and the add/refresh/import/export toolbar. (4) edit-feed-dialog: the edit form for the Hacker News feed, with the advanced settings for refresh frequency and proxy. (5) settings-dialog: the two-pane settings dialog. One thing changed data: opening the article marked it read after the 5-second delay, which lowered the unread count from 131 to 130 and dropped that article from the Unread list. I didn't save the search command palette because there were no slots left.
